Ved. singing correctly. --नीतिः f. Ved. right conduct. --मिताक्षरा N. of a commentary on Yājñavalkya's lawbook, generally called Mitākṣarā. --रोहितं the straight red bow of Indra. --वनि a. granting auspicious gifts.
